### Regions Financial Corp. to Participate in Barclays’ 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference


Aug 25, 2026


*Comments will be accessible via a live webcast.*


BIRMINGHAM, Ala.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Regions Financial Corp.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2F&esheet=54593850&newsitemid=20260825621595&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Financial+Corp.&index=1&md5=4a19e8c04c8962c68adb803486f3a2d4) (NYSE:RF) on Tuesday announced the company is scheduled to participate in Barclays’ 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference.


Regions leadership will take part in a fireside chat-style discussion with the conference moderator beginning at approximately 9 a.m. ET on **Tuesday, Sept. 15, 2026** . The discussion can be live-streamed in a listen-only format. To access the discussion, visit Regions’ Investor Relations page at[ir.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.regions.com&esheet=54593850&newsitemid=20260825621595&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.regions.com&index=2&md5=a57d4a03339c9106346bf61e8e5c7495) .


A replay will also be made available on the Investor Relations page following the event.


**About Regions Financial Corporation**


Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE:RF), with $161 billion in assets, is a member of the S&P 500 Index and is one of the nation’s largest full-service providers of consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. Regions serves customers across the South, Midwest and Texas, and through its subsidiary, Regions Bank, operates more than 1,200 banking offices and more than 1,750 ATMs. Regions Bank is an Equal Housing Lender and Member FDIC. Additional information about Regions and its full line of products and services can be found at[www.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com&esheet=54593850&newsitemid=20260825621595&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com&index=3&md5=ec3e3d7d254f34344990f8eff6673353) .
